title: Use the failure of a phase law to select a different construction
statement: The completed phase-law review accepts a representation-specific exponential relative-variance and constant-envelope rejection obstruction for independent finite phase alphabets and fixed-size correlated blocks in the displayed diagonal canonical model. The same-input difference-vector dynamic program provides an ordinary positive occupation comparator.

provides: The completed phase-law review accepts a representation-specific exponential relative-variance and constant-envelope rejection obstruction for independent finite phase alphabets and fixed-size correlated blocks in the displayed diagonal canonical model. assumptions: This is not physical hardness, a lower bound on all estimators, importance/MCMC sampling or every correlated field law. Globally correlated proposals, conditional integration, nonunitary factors and different estimators remain live; later correlated-boson work changes the representation rather than contradicting this barrier. The diagonal comparator does not solve noncommuting frustrated hopping.
